name: Grow Money! 💸
desc:
You're stranded on a deserted baseplate... with nothing but a seed.🌱 Can you turn it into a farming empire?

Grow money—even while you're offline! 💸

🚜[HOW TO PLAY]
- Equip a seed!
- Click in your plot to place it!
- Wait until it fully grows!
- Harvest your goods and sell them to earn money!
- Buy new seeds and become the richest player!


Like and favorite the game for future updates!

Inspired by Grow a Garden
